enemy-032-salvage-hive-brute.designLock: Original project Salvage Hive Brute adaptation informed only by the survival-horror atmosphere and recovered production corpus of the cancelled Aliens: Crucible project; it is not an attested Crucible creature name, a canon caste or a reconstruction of one disclosed design. Very stocky, low hive Xenomorph with huge shoulders, massive forearms and knuckles, protected low elongated eyeless organic head, thick ribbed black-brown chitinous torso, broad pelvis and powerful digitigrade legs. Exactly two arms and two legs. It is a low biped that may brace on one or both knuckles, never a permanent four-legged animal. Preserve toothed maw and restrained inner jaw, intact XX121 articulation, and one long segmented organic tail visibly connected at a thick sacral root and ending in one sharp tip. A few small asymmetrical oxidized salvage pieces and several dead charcoal cable loops are permanently trapped under matte amber hive resin on upper back, outer shoulder and flank. The debris remains passive, unpowered and identical across frames; it never replaces anatomy and never forms articulated armor, joints, a backpack, a weapon, machinery or an exoskeleton. Palette is black-brown/dark gunmetal organic carapace, restrained wet highlights, matte amber resin, sparse rust-brown metal, dead charcoal cable and ivory teeth; no clean or powered hardware and no pink/magenta anatomy or reflected chroma light. Strict right-facing orthographic side profile in every pose. Preserve skull shield, heavy shoulder/forearm mass, limb count, salvage placement, cable loops, tail root, palette, scale and contact line across idle, move, attack, death and charge. No Fallout mutant, chain, club, held object, powered light, screen, firearm, mech, cyborg or copied leaked Crucible creature.
